name: Welcome to MackTack
summary:
"Welcome to MackTack" is a visceral and immersive horror experience developed exclusively for VR on Meta Quest 2 and 3. You begin isolated in your cabin on a rainy night when a simple call from a friend triggers a series of disturbing events. After opening the door, you're kidnapped and wake up in a makeshift surgical room, legless and surrounded by mutilated bodies. A sadistic clown, MackTack, will relentlessly hunt you as you fight to escape his twisted domain.
